title: Chapter 600 - 600 Thunder Calamity; Descent (2)
content:
Chapter 600 - 600 Thunder Calamity; Descent (2)

Chapter 600 - 600 Thunder Calamity; Descent (2)

600 Thunder Calamity; Descent (2)

Instantly, all the monsters stared at Lin Fan with their scarlet eyes.

From afar, they looked like ghost lights in the dark night.

They were extremely terrifying!

Moreover, as time passed, the number of ghost lights continued to increase!

The Heavenly Hound opened its mouth and let out a bark. All the fur on its body stood up. It was ready to attack at any moment.

Lin Fan’s expression changed from the initial rage to indifference and calmness.

It was the omen of a storm!

Finally, Lin Fan opened his mouth wide and said, “Looks like this is a forest of demons.

“This demon forest should be punished!”

As the sound of Lin Fan’s voice faded, a huge bolt of lightning suddenly appeared in the originally clear sky.

The ferocious lightning seemed to have torn countless cracks in the sky.

Suddenly, a strong wind blew.

The branches shook violently, and countless scarlet leaves fell.

Clouds gathered rapidly, covering the sky.

The sky darkened at a speed visible to the naked eye.

This change surprised the red monsters.

They raised their heads and looked around. Their ferocious faces were filled with confusion.

Another burst of terrifying lightning, like countless lightning snakes swimming in the air, completely illuminated the faces of the monsters. It dyed them pale!

Then, the entire sky suddenly fell silent again.

The wind and trees stopped rustling.

“Punish!”

Lin Fan hollered out. His voice was like the words of a god. It was empty, holy, and rippling through the heaven and earth.

In an instant, it was like a huge thunder that split the sky and earth, exploding everyone’s ears.

Countless lightning pillars as thick as buckets rained down on the mangroves.

Heavenly punishment descended!

The monsters’ scarlet eyes shrank slightly as they hurriedly dodged to the side.

However, it was futile.

Thunderclaps continued, shaking the earth and mountains.

The trees fell, the soil shattered, and the entire world turned pale.

A moment later, the lightning slowly dissipated, adding a touch of color to the pale world.

Threads of tiny lightning snakes were still jumping in the forest.

The dense red forest had already disappeared.

What replaced it was a small forest that was covered in black smoke.

The red monsters all disappeared, as if they had never existed in this world.

Meanwhile, Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, and Sam were standing perfectly fine within the charred forest.

The entire world was dead silent!

A breeze blew from afar, blowing two charred trees that had lost their vitality to the ground.

At this moment, an emotionless voice rang out in Lin Fan’s ears.

[The first to destroy a level-five forbidden area. You’ve obtained a level-five treasure chest.]

[The first to destroy a level-five forbidden area. Hua Nation descends into a forbidden area.]

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Xiao Bing looked at the sky full of lightning in the live broadcast room, as well as the charred mangroves in the end. She said in a daze, “Just… What just happened?”

As Xiao Bing’s voice fell, the originally silent live broadcast room instantly erupted.

Forgive: [F*ck!]

Only You: [F*ck!]

The only person: [F*ck!]

Qingchuan Calendar Hanyang Tree: [F*ck!]

…

The entire screen was filled with countless exclamations.

Then, different bullet comments appeared.

Names Are Nothing but Floating Clouds: [God Lin first said that it was a demon forest and should be punished. Then, he sent lightning down and destroyed the entire forest!!!]

Answer: [I don’t know what words to use to describe God Lin. I can only say, he’s f*cking awesome!!!]

Ruffian Hero: [First, he can jump dozens of meters. Then, he killed someone with a slap. Later, he released sword energy and froze a tsunami… Now, he released lightning. God Lin, you still say that you’re not a god?!]

Past is Memories: [God Lin, you’re awesome!]]

Speechless Ending: [Those monsters actually killed so many people. God Lin, good job!]

Tearful Fish: [Good job!]

Abyss: [God Lin is right. That was indeed a demon forest!]

Wind: [He destroyed the demons with one word! Awesome!]

…

In fact, it was not just the Hua people who were cheering.

Many foreigners were also cheering.

That was because the heroes of their country were among the people who were brutally killed by the monsters in the mangroves.

They had long hated the red monsters to the core.

Now, Lin Fan had helped them take revenge.

…

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Qin Yuxuan, and the others all heaved a sigh of relief.

Then, a smile appeared on all the women’s faces.

Not only was Lin Fan fine, but he had also displayed even greater strength.

He was even safer now.

…

While the audience was discussing, Lin Fan placed his attention in front of him. The mysterious treasure chest was flashing with a strange light.

Then, he slowly opened it.

[You’ve obtained Beginner Light of Life. Do you want to use it?]

At the same time, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—Advanced Light of Life.]

Lin Fan’s body warmed up.

Then, many life particles appeared in his vision.

Lin Fan had a feeling that as long as he willed it, these life particles would be able to gather and heal the injuries of himself or others.

Lin Fan raised his head slowly and said to the Heavenly Hound, “Go and use the Beginner Light of Life.”

The Heavenly Hound had long been envious.

When it heard Lin Fan’s words, it did not hesitate any longer and moved its claws over.

Instantly, a faint light wrapped around the Heavenly Hound like a veil and quickly entered its body.

The Heavenly Hound’s eyes lit up even more.

Lin Fan was not too bothered by this and turned his gaze to Sam.

He was just about to condense the Light of Life.

At this moment, the Heavenly Hound stretched out its paw and placed it on Sam’s body.

A warm light immediately shot out from the hound’s paw and entered Sam’s body.

Sam’s body was covered in light, faintly emitting a holy aura.

When the light disappeared, he opened his eyes.

Sam looked at the charred forest in front of him, which was smoking. He could not help but ask, “M-Master, where are we?”

Then, he seemed to have thought of something and hurriedly said, “Master, where are those monsters? Where are the red-skinned monsters?!”

As he spoke, he suddenly jumped up. He clenched his hands into fists and scanned his surroundings.

It was as if he was on guard against the sudden appearance of a monster.

Clearly, he had completely recovered.

Lin Fan said calmly, “It’s fine now. Let’s go.”

As he spoke, he slowly walked forward.

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Jenny Turtle: [Beginner Light of Life, what a magical thing.]

Come Back: [The Light of Life. It’s like a priest in the game. Sam woke up in an instant.]

Say You Love Me: [Priest? I think it should be a bishop.]

Everyone, Rest Early: [With this Light of Life, will it be easy to treat illnesses in the future? Cancer, high blood pressure… Does that mean we don’t have to be afraid anymore?]

Qing Tian: What forbidden land did God Lin destroy just now? What does it mean? Oh right, Hua Nation has also descended a forbidden area. What is that?]

Glory: [Yes, everyone, check if there are any changes near your city.]

Boundless Sea and Sky: [The forbidden area might be like what we see in the movies and novels. There’ll be many benefits.]

Illusion: [Yes! Quick, take a look!]

Windstorm: [F*ck! A large forest suddenly appeared in the suburbs of Yang City in Jiang Province. It’s a mangroves forest!]

Ruthless: [What? Mangroves!]

…

When countless viewers saw this comment, they could not help but shiver.

They had already seen how terrifying the mangroves were.

Could those monsters be in the mangroves in Yang City?

Would the monsters come out?

This was definitely a very terrifying thing.
